method: Apply preregistered observed-quality and paired-resource gates,not a statistical population-equivalence test. Local controls passed before dispatch; complete non-description execution text is unchanged.

registeredGate.qualityFirst: Do not promote if candidate has fewer full audited completions or behavior passes than baseline in any task cluster, or introduces a reproducible behavior/type defect in the local guards. Keep stochastic and causal attribution limits explicit.
registeredGate.resourceSignal: At no lower audited quality, look for at least10% reduction in strict paired tokens or estimated cost, with estimated cost increase no greater than5% and worker time increase no greater than10%. A selected-success subset cannot override all-attempt quality.
registeredGate.retain: If quality and resource gates pass across this fixed panel, retain concise descriptions provisionally with unchanged runtime guards; still require independent real-issue confirmation before a population gain claim.
registeredGate.mixedOrAdverse: Keep the prototype isolated and investigate the observed mediator; do not extend the panel or revise criteria after outcomes to force a positive result.

limitation: Three constructed clusters on one new project,dependent repeats,unblinded model labels/review and unknown provider revision/seeds limit external validity. Length and wording emphasis are not separately identified. A selected successful subset cannot erase all-attempt failures. No outcome-based extra trials.
